text: 1) Application form(can be downloaded in portal when all the information is filled);2) Scanned copy of passport including photo page and visa page with at least 6 months validity from the submission of the application;3) Recent 2-inch color photo (white background);4) High school diploma (notarized photocopy in Chinese or English); Provisional graduation certificate is acceptable upon application, while the official Senior High School Diploma shall be submitted prior to registration at ZCMU;5) Transcript for all the courses in senior high school (notarized copy in Chinese/English)6) Physical Examination Report (issued in recent 6 months).7) Police Clearance Certificate (issued in recent 6 months).8) For applicants already in China, study certificate/working certificate is required;9) Other documents (if necessary).
